note: M1 from PLANNER Phase 1b. Three arms over one task set and one scorer, so the comparisons are internally valid. no-tickets: the constraint died in chat. with-tickets: the ticket is in the tree and nothing points the agent at it -- this is the behavioural tier the install targets rely on. with-tickets-prompted: the same tree plus one sentence telling the agent to consult tickets, which is the condition the 2026-08-30 published run used. with-tickets minus no-tickets is the unprompted lift; with-tickets-prompted minus with-tickets is what the reminder buys. Keys were authored from the fixture before any run and are frozen.
